reason: The README describes an observe-only DeepSeek Harness bundle that monitors tool and session events and records hashed, hash-chained JSONL evidence receipts locally without registering tools or modifying prompts, results, or session publications.

summaries.zh: 一个用于观察 DeepSeek Harness 工具和会话事件并将哈希链式证据收据写入本地 JSONL 文件的审计插件。
summaries.en: An audit plugin that observes DeepSeek Harness tool and session events and writes hash-chained evidence receipts to a local JSONL file.

capabilities: Observes DeepSeek Harness tools/result and session/event publications
Hashes selected event identifiers and payload-derived values
Appends hash-chained JSONL evidence receipts to a local file
Verifies the existing receipt chain at startup
